messages.text: My Tern stopped responding to MIDI clock after the 1.9.4 update. Notes still play.
Thanks for the detail. In 1.9.4 clock input moved to its own setting: hold SHIFT and press STEP 12, then set CLK SRC to MIDI.
That was it. Arpeggiator is locked to the drum machine again.
Filter cutoff knob jumps from about 30% to 70% when I turn it slowly.
That sounds like a worn potentiometer track. Is the unit still under the two-year warranty? The serial is on the underside, starting HT-.
HT-2207-0419, bought last spring.
Covered. I have opened a repair order and emailed a prepaid shipping label. Turnaround is usually eight working days.
Wie kann ich meine Patches sichern, bevor ich die Firmware aktualisiere?
Über PatchSync: USB anschließen, in der App 'Bank exportieren' wählen. Es entsteht eine .tbank-Datei mit allen 128 Speicherplätzen.
Danke, hat geklappt.
Our payout for Friday shows 'held'. Nothing changed on our side.
The hold is a bank-detail check: the account number on file was edited on Thursday. Once the micro-deposit is confirmed the payout is released the same day.
Someone on our team did update the IBAN. Confirming now.
Confirmed on our side too. The payout is scheduled for the 16:00 run.
We get 429 responses on POST /payments during our evening peak, roughly 40 per minute.
Your account is on the default limit of 100 writes per second. Are you retrying immediately on 429, or honouring the Retry-After header?
Immediately, in a loop. I see the problem.
Backing off with jitter and honouring Retry-After should clear it. If peaks still exceed the limit after that, we can review a raise with your traffic graph.
Nous avons reçu un litige pour une commande livrée. Quels justificatifs faut-il fournir ?
La preuve de livraison avec numéro de suivi, la facture et, si possible, les échanges avec le client. Le délai de réponse est de 10 jours.
Is there a way to power the Tern from USB-C instead of the 12 V adapter?
The current board needs 12 V for the analogue filter, so USB-C power alone is not supported. A USB-C PD trigger cable set to 12 V works if it can supply 1 A.
Good to know, ordering one.
Which documents do you need to verify a sole trader account?
Proof of identity, proof of address dated within three months, and a bank statement in the business name or your own name if you trade under it.
Uploaded all three.
Thank you. Verification usually completes within one working day; you will see the status change in Settings > Business.
Factory patch 'Low Tide' sounds thin compared to the demo video.
The demo uses the external 'Harbour' reverb at about 30% mix. On the Tern itself, try raising SUB to 0.6 and opening VCF RES slightly.
Much closer now, thanks.
¿Por qué el importe del pago es menor que la suma de las ventas del día?
Se descuentan las comisiones por transacción y un reembolso emitido el miércoles. El informe de liquidación desglosa cada partida.
Ahora lo veo en el informe. Gracias.
Webhook deliveries to our endpoint fail with 'signature mismatch' since this morning.
Did the endpoint secret rotate? The dashboard shows a new secret created at 08:12 UTC; deliveries are signed with the newest one.
Our deploy still had the old secret. Updated, failures have stopped.
Great. The 23 failed events will be retried automatically over the next hour, or you can replay them from the Webhooks page.
Order shows shipped for six days but tracking has not moved.
I am sorry about the wait. The carrier has the parcel at their regional hub; I have opened a trace and will update you within 48 hours.
シーケンサーのスイング設定はどこにありますか？
SHIFT を押しながら STEP 7 を押すと SWING が表示されます。50% から 75% まで設定できます。
見つかりました。ありがとうございます。
A burst of small payments came in overnight, all from new cards, all €1.00.
That pattern is typical of card testing. I have enabled the velocity rule for your account and the payments are being refunded automatically.
Will we be charged fees for those?
No. Fees on payments refunded under a fraud rule are waived; you will see them reversed on the next settlement report.
The settlement CSV opens with broken accents in our spreadsheet tool.
The file is UTF-8 without a byte-order mark. Importing it with UTF-8 selected, rather than opening it directly, keeps the accents.
Works with import. Could you add a BOM option?
I have logged the request with the reporting team.
I'd like to return the Tern. It's lovely, just not for me.
No problem, you are within the 30-day window. A return label is on its way; once it arrives the refund takes 3 to 5 working days.
Displayen flimrar när enheten har varit på i en timme.
Tack. Händer det även med en annan strömadapter? Vissa adaptrar ger rippel som syns i displayen.
Med en annan adapter är det borta.
Då skickar vi en ny originaladapter utan kostnad.
Can I set an idempotency key on refunds as well as payments?
Yes. Every POST accepts the Idempotency-Key header, and keys are kept for 24 hours.
Can payouts go out daily instead of weekly?
Daily payouts are available once an account has 60 days of processing history. Yours reaches that on the 2nd of next month, and I have set a reminder to switch it.
Perfect.
PatchSync says 'bank checksum mismatch' when I import a friend's bank.
That usually means the file was altered in transit, for example opened and resaved as text. Could they send it zipped?
The zipped copy imported fine.
We lost a dispute although we uploaded the delivery proof.
The issuer's note says the proof showed a different address from the order. If the customer asked for a redirect, that message would be new evidence for a second-cycle response.
They did, by email. Sending it over.
Received and attached. The second response goes to the issuer today.
Can the LFO sync to tempo?
Yes, since 1.8: set LFO SYNC to a note value (1/4, 1/8, 1/16 or 1/8T). It follows the internal tempo or incoming MIDI clock.
Posso aceitar pagamentos em reais e receber em euros?
Sim. Os pagamentos em BRL são convertidos na liquidação; a taxa e o spread aparecem no relatório de cada lote.
Does the price include import duties for Norway?
Orders to Norway ship duty-paid, so there is nothing extra to pay on delivery.
Thanks, ordering today.
Your risk rules declined a large order from a long-standing customer.
The decline was the geo-mismatch rule: card country and IP country differed. You can allow-list that customer under Risk > Trusted customers.
Done, and they've paid now.
One of the step buttons needs a hard press to register.
Which step? A single button usually needs a new membrane contact, which we can send with fitting instructions, or we can do it under warranty.
Step 9. I'd rather you do it.
Repair order opened; shipping label sent.
Can I get the settlement report pushed to an SFTP server every morning?
Scheduled exports support SFTP. Add the host under Reports > Schedules; we connect from 198.51.100.24 and 198.51.100.25, if you need to allow-list them.
Das Gerät kam mit einem Kratzer auf der Frontplatte an.
Das tut uns leid. Möchten Sie einen Austausch oder eine Teilerstattung von 15 %?
Die Teilerstattung reicht mir.
Ist veranlasst, der Betrag erscheint in 3 bis 5 Werktagen.
Is there a sandbox card that triggers a 3-D Secure challenge?
Use the test card ending 3155 with any future expiry. The sandbox challenge page accepts the code 1234.
After updating, all my user patches loaded with the filter fully closed.
That is a known issue in 1.9.3 when upgrading from 1.7 or earlier: the cutoff range was rescaled. 1.9.4 converts old patches correctly; re-import your backup after updating.
Re-imported on 1.9.4 and they sound right again.
